_readme: Events that happen during a stage. Each event has a stage, a station (a place on the ship) and facts written as { "value": ..., "source": ... }. A source is a link, a written game-design choice, or the word PLACEHOLDER (made up for now; a student replaces it before the final submission). The Mars shadow pass is NOT here: it is a Mars-orbit event and lives in game_data.json (events, power_low). The words on the screen are in data/inner_voice.json (flight) and data/story.json (flight).

station.source: Game-design choice: the Water station in the Life Support room (A10).

start_after_seconds.source: PLACEHOLDER (seconds after the Flight leg starts)

drain_liters_per_second.source: PLACEHOLDER (extra water lost every real second until the leak is fixed)

fix.source: Game-design choice: press E at the Water station.
